en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Husayn Bin ssayf, from Abu Jameela, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When the servant frequents in seeking the Forgiveness, his parchment (record of deeds) is raised and it would be gleaming’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Husayn ibn Sayf from abu Jamilah from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurara who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘One who pleas for forgiveness often, his book of record of deeds is raised and it shines brilliantly.’”
